 Senegal make 8 changes to their XI from the 4 October match against Comoros. K. Appiah’s Sudan name the same XI as against Mozambique.

 Senegal - Sudan
 — At a glance
 Senegal v Sudan takes place this Thursday 12 November 2026 at 19:00 GMT, at the Stade Léopold-Sédar-Senghor in Dakar.
 The match is on matchday 3 of the group stage in qualifying for the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations.
 Patrick Vieira sets Senegal up in a 3-4-3.
 K. Appiah’s Sudan line up in a 4-2-3-1.
 The key points
 The match: Senegal v Sudan, 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers, group stage matchday 3, kick-off at 19:00 GMT
 Senegal: 3-4-3 system, 8 changes from the previous match
 Sudan: 4-2-3-1 system, no changes from the previous match
 Senegal v Sudan takes place this Thursday 12 November 2026 at 19:00 GMT, at the Stade Léopold-Sédar-Senghor in Dakar, on matchday 3 of the group stage in qualifying for the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations.
 Patrick Vieira sets Senegal up in a 3-4-3, with 8 changes from the 4 October match against Comoros, which they won 1-0 in a friendly. The new starters are Yehvann Diouf , Sadibou Sané , Moussa Niakhaté , Dion Lopy, Lamine Camara , El Diouf, Boulaye Dia and Nicolas Jackson . Up front, Iliman Baroy Ndiaye lines up alongside Boulaye Dia and Nicolas Jackson.
 Current form
 Senegal W L D W W 
 Sudan L W L 
 Head to head
 2026-01-03 · Senegal 3-1 Sudan
 2025-09-05 · Senegal 2-0 Sudan
 2025-08-29 · Sudan 1-1 Senegal
 Key figures
 8 Senegal changes 1-0 friendly win 4-1 qualifying defeat K. Appiah’s Sudan line up in a 4-2-3-1 with no changes from the 29 September match against Mozambique, a 4-1 defeat in Africa Cup of Nations qualifying. Mohamed Mustafa starts in goal behind Yaser Awad Boshara, A. Kuku, Mustafa Karshom and Ahmed Yousif Tabanja, while Mohamed Eisa leads the line on his own.
